label: SpecRequirement
text: ServiceAccountRef.DenoSpec converts the CRD service-account reference into denospec.ServiceAccountRef, copying name and namespace, and returns nil for a nil receiver.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Every reconcilable kind exposes a phase string alias describing its lifecycle states: DenoPodPhase, DenoRunPhase, DenoJobPhase, RunTriggerPhase, PolicyEnginePhase, PolicyWorkflowPodPhase and PolicyWorkflowPhase.

label: SpecRequirement
text: DenoPermissions.DenoSpec converts the CRD permission block into the denospec.Permissions struct, mapping every permission field, and returns nil for a nil receiver.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Each custom kind (DenoPod, DenoRun, DenoJob, RunTrigger, PolicyEngine, PolicyWorkflowPod, PolicyWorkflowRun, OpenBao) has a root type, a matching List type, a Spec and a Status struct.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Type behaviour and deep-copy invariants stay covered by the package tests in types_test.go and deno_types_test.go.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Every API type has generated DeepCopyInto and DeepCopy methods so handlers and caches never share backing arrays or maps.

label: SpecRequirement
text: The v1alpha1 group-version registers every custom kind plus its list type with the scheme so clients and informers can decode them.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Every root kind and its List type implement DeepCopyObject returning runtime.Object so they satisfy runtime.Object for the scheme and client code.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Deep copy of a kind with slices such as DenoJob must not alias the source slices, verified by TestDenoJobDeepCopyDoesNotAlias.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Shared types ServiceAccountRef, DenoPermission, DenoPermissions, DenoPodTemplate, ExecProbe, DenoRestartPolicy and ConcurrencyPolicy carry the reusable pod, permission and probe configuration used across the kinds.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Every configuration value comes from a flag whose default is the environment variable, and the environment is read through envOr for strings and envOrInt64 for integers, which ignore an empty or unparseable variable and use the fallback.

label: SpecRequirement
text: main runs providerImpl.Run under a context cancelled by SIGINT or SIGTERM, and exits with status 1 and a logged error if Run returns an error.

label: SpecRequirement
text: The package provides a main function that acts as the provider process entrypoint and holds no reconcile logic.

label: SpecRequirement
text: The host passed to the registry and the provider is the kubeconfig's server unless --host is set, in which case the flag wins.

label: SpecRequirement
text: main sets KUBE_FEATURE_WatchListClient to false before any client-go call, because kcp's APIExport virtual workspace sends no bookmark and an informer's initial list would otherwise never complete.

label: SpecRequirement
text: main exits with status 2 and a message on stderr when neither --kubeconfig nor KUBECONFIG is set.

label: SpecRequirement
text: readIfSet returns nil and logs a warning, rather than failing startup, when the PEM file named by the OpenBao CA flag cannot be read, so an https vault surfaces as a failed TLS verification instead of a provider that will not start.

label: SpecRequirement
text: When --bundled-actions-dir is empty, main derives it as the policy engine directory joined with /../policies/gha-lite/bundled-actions.

label: SpecRequirement
text: defaultRunTTL answers nil for a negative seconds value, which disables the default run TTL, and otherwise returns a pointer to the value.

label: SpecRequirement
text: caData returns the rest config's CAData when present, otherwise the contents of CAFile when it can be read, otherwise nil.

label: SpecRequirement
text: The exec pod runner's TrustBundle is a closure that returns the kubeconfig CA data from caData while the provider is nil and providerImpl.TrustBundle once the provider exists, because the OpenBao root CA does not exist before a namespace requests a certificate.

label: SpecRequirement
text: main builds the registry, the engine runner, the exec pod runner, and then the provider, exiting with status 1 and a logged error when any construction fails.

label: SpecRequirement
text: The deploy manifests stay consistent with the Go types: validate.py maps each sc.kind.* to its schema file and each APIExport to its export file, then checks upstream api.short against names.shortNames[0], api.resource against names.plural, and upstream phases and conditions against the Go Phase* and Condition* constants.

label: SpecRequirement
text: APIExport denoruntime lists denopods, denoruns, denojobs, runtriggers, policyengines, policyworkflowpods and openbaos in group deno.computer, each pointing at its versioned APIResourceSchema name with CRD storage.

label: SpecRequirement
text: APIExport policyworkflowruns publishes the single policyworkflowruns resource in group deno.computer against schema v1alpha1-4.policyworkflowruns.deno.computer.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Each schema metadata.name is the versioned resource string v1alpha1-N.<plural>.deno.computer, with N unique per kind: openbaos 1, denoruns 2, policyengines 2, denopods 3, runtriggers 3, denojobs 4, policyworkflowruns 4, policyworkflowpods 5.

label: SpecRequirement
text: WorkspaceType denoruntime extends workflow and universal from root and defaults both API bindings, policyworkflowruns and denoruntime, at path root:deno-provider.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Required spec fields are exactly: DenoPod script; DenoRun script; DenoJob template; RunTrigger policyWorkflowPod and jobTemplate; PolicyWorkflowPod workflow and policyEngine; OpenBao namespace. PolicyEngine and PolicyWorkflowRun declare no required spec fields.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Every schema version enables subresources.status, so phase and conditions are written by the provider and not by the tenant.

label: SpecRequirement
text: WorkspaceType workflow extends universal from root and defaults the API binding for export policyworkflowruns at path root:deno-provider.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Each schema spec.names declares kind, listKind, plural, singular and shortNames: DenoPod/dpod, DenoRun/drun, DenoJob/djob, RunTrigger/rtrig, PolicyEngine/peng, PolicyWorkflowPod/pwpod, PolicyWorkflowRun/pwr, OpenBao/obao.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Every APIResourceSchema declares group deno.computer, scope Namespaced, and a single v1alpha1 version that is both served and stored.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Each kind's status carries a conditions array of objects with x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields, so standard condition sets can be added without a schema change.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Status phase enums are fixed per kind: DenoPod, DenoRun and DenoJob use Pending/Running/Succeeded/Failed; RunTrigger uses Pending/Triggered/Skipped/Failed; PolicyEngine and PolicyWorkflowPod use Pending/Running/Failed; PolicyWorkflowRun uses Pending/Running/Succeeded/Failed/Cancelled; OpenBao carries no phase and reports ready plus message instead.

label: SpecRequirement
text: policyworkflowpod.yaml instantiates Kind PolicyWorkflowPod, resource policyworkflowpods, checked against policyworkflowpod-apiresourceschema.yaml.

label: SpecRequirement
text: openbao-tls-pod.yaml also instantiates Kind DenoPod, resource denopods, against denopod-apiresourceschema.yaml, showing the pod wired to OpenBao over TLS.

label: SpecRequirement
text: policy-workflow-run.yaml instantiates Kind PolicyWorkflowRun, resource policyworkflowruns, checked against policyworkflowrun-apiresourceschema.yaml.

label: SpecRequirement
text: deno-run.yaml instantiates Kind DenoRun, resource denoruns, checked against denorun-apiresourceschema.yaml.

label: SpecRequirement
text: deno-pod.yaml instantiates Kind DenoPod, resource denopods, checked against denopod-apiresourceschema.yaml.

label: SpecRequirement
text: deploy/examples contains exactly ten YAML manifests: deno-job.yaml, deno-pod.yaml, deno-run.yaml, native-fire-pod.yaml, openbao-tls-pod.yaml, openbao.yaml, policy-workflow-run.yaml, policyengine.yaml, policyworkflowpod.yaml and runtrigger.yaml.

label: SpecRequirement
text: exampleFilesOnDisk reads the local examples directory, skips subdirectories and every entry that is not a .yaml file, and returns the surviving names sorted.

label: SpecRequirement
text: The names returned by exampleFilesOnDisk equal the set of File fields in exampleFiles, so adding or removing a manifest on disk without updating the registry fails the integration suite.

label: SpecRequirement
text: openbao.yaml instantiates Kind OpenBao, resource openbaos, checked against openbao-apiresourceschema.yaml.

label: SpecRequirement
text: runtrigger.yaml instantiates Kind RunTrigger, resource runtriggers, checked against runtrigger-apiresourceschema.yaml.

label: SpecRequirement
text: deno-job.yaml instantiates Kind DenoJob, resource denojobs, checked against denojob-apiresourceschema.yaml.

label: SpecRequirement
text: exampleByName returns the registry entry matching a given file name and reports false when no entry matches, so an unknown example is a lookup miss and not a zero value.

label: SpecRequirement
text: policyengine.yaml instantiates Kind PolicyEngine, resource policyengines, checked against policyengine-apiresourceschema.yaml.

label: SpecRequirement
text: DenoPod is exercised by three separate manifests (deno-pod.yaml, native-fire-pod.yaml, openbao-tls-pod.yaml) so a single Kind is covered by more than one configuration.

label: SpecRequirement
text: native-fire-pod.yaml also instantiates Kind DenoPod, resource denopods, against denopod-apiresourceschema.yaml, demonstrating the same kind with a different runtime path.

label: SpecRequirement
text: Every manifest in deploy/examples is referenced by the integration registry, so the directory holds no manifest that the suite does not validate.

label: SpecRequirement
text: exampleFiles returns the registry of all ten examples in a fixed order, each entry carrying File, Kind, Resource and Schema.

intent: This context exists so the deno.computer API surface can be installed into a local kcp instance as declarative YAML: the APIResourceSchemas are the single definition of each kind's spec and status, the APIExports are what tenant workspaces bind to, and the WorkspaceTypes are what gives a tenant workspace that binding by default. Tooling and scripts consume these files by path, so the file names, schema names, kind names, shortNames and phase enums are a contract and not decoration.
label: SpecContext
name: deploy

intent: This context exists so the deploy/examples directory and the test-side registry that describes it are specified as one unit rather than as an untracked pile of YAML. The examples are the smoke-test fixtures for every custom resource the operator ships, so the specification pins three things at once: which ten manifests are present, which Kind/resource/schema each one maps to, and the invariant that the on-disk listing and the in-code listing stay in step. Anything that adds, renames or removes an example breaks the pairing, and the requirements below make that breakage explicit instead of silent.
label: SpecContext
name: deploy-examples

intent: This context exists to be the process entrypoint for the deno-kcp provider controller. Everything it does is wiring: turn command line flags and environment variables into a config, refuse to start without a kubeconfig, build the registry, engine runner, pod runner and provider in the order their dependencies require, and then run the provider until a termination signal arrives. The two non-obvious behaviours it encodes are the KUBE_FEATURE_WatchListClient opt-out, which stops a streaming list from hanging when kcp's APIExport virtual workspace sends no bookmark, and the deferred TrustBundle closure, which exists because the OpenBao root CA does not exist until a namespace has requested a certificate and the provider that generates it is built from the runner being constructed. It is deliberately thin, holding no reconcile logic of its own.
label: SpecContext
name: cmd-deno-kcp-provider

intent: This context exists so the operator can persist and reconcile deno-kcp custom resources through the Kubernetes API machinery. The package defines the on-cluster schema (specs, statuses, phase enums), the list types the informers and clientsets need, the kubebuilder deep-copy implementations that keep informer caches free of aliasing bugs, and the bridge that turns the CRD-shaped DenoPermissions and ServiceAccountRef into the denospec types the runtime layer consumes. It is the shared vocabulary between the controllers, the provider registry and the denospec execution library.
label: SpecContext
name: api-v1alpha1
